blast_radius._note: 187 is what the dispatch gate measures: `git grep -c 'INTO ' origin/master -- src tests examples`. It is NOT the scope of this task. I first declared 139, a docs-only count, and the gate correctly refused — it measures a fixed path set that excludes docs/, so a docs-only number is an answer to a different question. The ACTIONABLE scope is 37 statements (lines matching '^\\s*INTO ') across the 8 anchored docs/ files; raw 'INTO ' substring counts per file are in the anchors, and differ because prose says 'INSERT INTO' and 'INTO clauses'. Three numbers, three questions: 187 = gate's src/tests/examples reach, ~139 = docs-wide substrings, 37 = statements to rewrite.

grammar_reference._note: The supported form is `CREATE STREAM <sink> AS SELECT ... FROM <source> WITH (...)`. A Kafka sink needs ALL THREE of '<name>.type', '<name>.bootstrap.servers' and '<name>.topic' — naming only .type validates as `Missing Sink Configs: bootstrap.servers, topic`. COPY_PASTE_EXAMPLES.md:246 is the canonical worked example.

tests._note: Docs-only. The gate is `velo-cli validate` on every rewritten block, requiring `Valid files: 1`. No unit tests are added; the #1925 doc-SQL gate does not cover these files (that is #1938).

stop_conditions: a fan-out example's intent is genuinely ambiguous — which of the N sinks was meant — STOP and report that example rather than guessing
a rewritten block will not validate after adding the three sink properties — STOP and report, do not weaken the example to make it pass
more than 8 files need touching — STOP; the scope was measured and anything beyond it is a different issue
